topology: One unmodified UsbWorker from default SessionController factory -> direct _GroundFrameInbox -> DeviceQualitySession -> GaitEngine. No offline source, second USB worker, per-frame observer/retention, renderer install, or recording. Production ExecutionView, production camera preview/decoder, inference, SDK full-body checkbox and pose draw checkbox enabled.
cold: First formal session of a fresh Python process, after original hardware preflight and first real camera render/SDK start. Not OS reboot, file-cache purge, device power-cycle or completely un-warmed preflight. Startup timestamps retained.
warm: Second same-mode session in the same process after a completed 30-second cold empty session and 3-second inter-session pause. Keep the original real camera/SDK/vision alive; original controller stop and prepare create the next USB/engine session. No gc.collect or algorithm warmup injection.
mode_parameters: Unmodified WalkingConfig/OvergroundRunningConfig defaults. Original quality readiness and acknowledgement path; no threshold changes.
observers: Byte-identical previous QueueProbe P, common batch-boundary/64 bucket snapshots plus 10Hz sampler; count original GUI renders and actual pose drawing as in prior experiment; existing SDK telemetry counters. No per-frame arrival/USB callback observer, call tree, CPU sampler, ETW, additional live frame archive or camera recorder.
windows: First 11 formal host seconds primary; formal 11..30 seconds secondary; preflight/startup and stop/drain separate. Consumer fps measured from batch sample progress and host time, not microbenchmarks. Pending age is real queue-head receipt age; batch state includes partial batch uncertainty.

reproduction_gate.rule: Every phase retained. At least one valid initial-empty phase meeting all conditions triggers the conditional native-scheduling stage; report counts and ranges, no repeat-until-success. No reproduction is not proof of dense-motion performance.

validity: Real eight-segment capture, one CyUsbInterfaceReader, camera enabled and actual renders>0, SDK tracking_start success and no control failure, full-duration manual stop, raw archive untruncated, no unexplained device counter gaps or quality acquisition failure. Report raw usable-contact density and events; motion/quality contamination remains separate. Effective pose draws may be zero in an unmanned scene and must be reported, not fabricated.
evidence: Original OvergroundSession raw contact bits/device timestamps and full report/quality/runtime state retained after original stop. No extra SensorFrame list or secondary signal callback. This is not a full wire-packet capture or a deterministic replay oracle. Source hashes and original observer identity frozen before formal repetitions.
native_stage: Only if valid sustained initial-empty shortage reproduces. Independently calibrate minimal Windows thread-scheduling recording before interpreting Running/Ready/Waiting/context switches; no new drawing A/B. No automatic GIL/GC attribution.
control: Native enabled Windows desktop task, no screenshot during formal trials, read progress about once per minute. Functional smoke screenshot only; failed attempts retained under new names. No OS reboot or external app termination.
